name: orb_15min_filtered_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's first 15 minutes (09:15-09:30 = 180 bars at 5s) is the overnight information absorption window — gap resolution, pre-open auction clearing, and large institutional limit book repricing all happen here. When VIX sits in the 13-20 Goldilocks zone, NIFTY's opening range is meaningful: below 13, ranges are too compressed and breakouts whipsaw as market makers trivially fade them; above 20, institutional flow is erratic and gap risk dominates. When price closes outside the 15-min range for two consecutive 5s bars and aligns with session VWAP, it signals that VWAP-benchmarked programs and CTA momentum algos have begun aggressively entering in the breakout direction — their flow sustains the move for 30-90 seconds before the first mean-reversion attempt.
core_signal_oneliner: 15-minute ORB breakout with 2-bar persistence, VWAP alignment, and VIX in the 13-20 Goldilocks zone restricting entries to 09:30-10:30
